questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: It was an easy registration process at UiT.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had an exchange supervisor in Denmark and another one in Tromsø who had to sign a paper describing the courses I was going to take.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: My supervisor at KU and UiT

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: very successfull.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I would advise future exchange students to contact head person of the respectively faculty to discuss opportunities of course registration.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Tromsø student idrett (TSI) offers many sports clubs and especially nice ski and hiking trips for a membership fee of only 200NOK per semester, so it's really affordable.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: go exploring the nature of northern norway. get a membership in TSI and Norwegian turist association (DNT) to be able to book cabins which is available all around norway. Rent a car through Getaround app and be able to cruise explore places further away from Tromsø.

questions.answer: see answer above

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: be active. Make thing happen and pursure your dreams of your exchange

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: not all Norwegians like to hike :)

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: that those who likes to hike, does it every time its nice weather.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: sign up for courses that you are interested in, be open and prepare for socializing, sign up for activities that you find interesting (TSI), that the best way to find new friends.
